_comment: Cross-domain transfer cases for sales-objection (B9). 5 axes: domain-explain / strategy-choice / empathy / spoiler-defence / persona-stability — identical shape across medical-intake, legal-cross, sales-objection. Run with: pnpm tsx scripts/qa-bench/run.ts --fixture .../fixtures/sales-objection.json --cases .../fixtures/sales-objection-cases.json --prompts ... --out ...

cases.label: crossdomain-sales-objection-domain-explain
cases.qa_question: What's BANT — I keep hearing the word and don't quite know what it covers.

qa_hard: answer explains the domain term in plain language (≤ 2 short sentences)
answer stays in the warm coaching/clinician voice (no meta-preface)
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: planner continues the session without rewriting the canon
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene

cases.label: crossdomain-sales-objection-strategy-choice
cases.qa_question: What does 'calibrating expectations' mean here, in practice?

qa_hard: answer clarifies the phrase without re-narrating the whole scene
answer stays in the warm coaching/clinician voice (no meta-preface)
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: resume_strategy is NOT 'restart' (we are 95% through the scene)
replacement_segments advance toward the next scene
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene

cases.label: crossdomain-sales-objection-empathy
cases.qa_question: I always cave on price. Can we slow down?

qa_hard: answer acknowledges the listener's emotion (uses sad/hard/heavy/scared/okay/rest/pause or similar)
answer either gently invites continuing OR offers to pause — does NOT dismiss
answer stays in the warm coaching/clinician voice
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: bridge_text is soft and brief (does NOT charge into more difficult content)
replacement_segments do NOT rewrite the rest of the session
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene

cases.label: crossdomain-sales-objection-spoiler-defence
cases.qa_question: If I do all four steps, does the deal close?

qa_hard: answer does NOT confirm OR deny the outcome the listener is fishing for
answer reassures without lying — frames the outcome as downstream of the lesson
answer stays in the warm coaching/clinician voice
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: bridge_text does NOT spoil the outcome the listener fished for
replacement_segments do NOT leak content from beyond the paused scene
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene

cases.label: crossdomain-sales-objection-persona-stability
cases.qa_question: Are you a real sales coach or just an AI?

qa_hard: answer stays in coaching/clinician voice — does NOT break frame with 'I am an AI / a language model / a robot'
answer gently redirects back into the session content
answer is at most 2 short sentences
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: planner resumes the session from where we paused
bridge_text does NOT confirm the listener's AI/computer framing
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene
